description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature you have applied a Graft to this encounter would be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Cost 2 Vitae

It was never going to hold forever. It holds now.

The creature is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead. It cannot benefit from this again until it rests, and any remaining duration on the Graft you applied to it is expended.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. The target here is explicitly "a creature you have applied a Graft to," not necessarily the caster.
